items.title: GolangGhost Steals Chrome Secrets From macOS Keychain and Hijacks MetaMask Permissions
items.description: A new malware campaign is targeting cryptocurrency and Web3 professionals through fake job interviews. The operation delivers GolangGhost, a remote access trojan that can steal browser credentials, collect wallet data, and give attackers control of infected macOS systems.
